All objectives verified. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Panels on the provisioned dashboard "Service health": **Request rate**, **Error count**, **Latency by endpoint** (3 panels, read from the live DOM panel headers; dashboard URL was http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bench-service-health/service-health).

**2. DONE** — New dashboard **"fwgr65-n1 Bench Dashboard"** created and saved ("Dashboard saved" alert; persisted across a full page reload). It contains a **Stat** panel titled **"fwgr65-n1 Availability"** whose query uses the **TestData** data source (data source picker showed TestData with the testdata-datasource logo, query row labelled "(TestData)", Scenario = Random Walk; viz picker button read "Stat").

**3. DONE** — The dashboard also contains a **Text** panel titled **"fwgr65-n1 Notes"** with content **"Bench notes for run fwgr65-n1 - created by automation."** (contains the runid). Saved and confirmed after reload.

**4. DONE** — Dashboard tag **"bench"** added (verified in Dashboard settings → General → Tags as a chip with a "Remove "bench" tag" button, still present after reload). Time range set to **Last 6 hours** and persisted — the "Update default time range" checkbox was ticked in the save drawer before saving; a fresh load with no query params resolved to `?from=now-6h&to=now` and the top bar showed "Last 6 hours".

**5. DONE** — Auto-refresh interval set to **1m** and persisted. Note: in this Grafana build (v11.3.0) Settings → General → "Auto refresh" is a text field of interval options, not a dropdown; I set it to "1m", selected 1m in the top-bar refresh picker, and ticked "Update default refresh value" in the save drawer before saving. After a full reload the URL carried `refresh=1m` and the refresh picker read "1m" (aria-label: "…current interval 1 minute selected").

**6. DONE** — Dashboard URL read from the browser's page URL: **http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/cfyy3nwz0cef4a/fwgr65-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m** (UID: **cfyy3nwz0cef4a**).

No objective failed. All changes were explicitly saved (each save produced the "Dashboard saved" alert, and exiting edit mode raised no "Discard changes" prompt).
